name: Stanford Clinical Summer Internship (MEDCSI)
what_you_do: You take a two-week hands-on medicine course with skills like ultrasound, dissection and suturing. This is a fee-based program. You pay to attend, and it is not a job.
who_can_apply: 16 by start; strongly suggested to have taken high school biology. Needs transcripts, resume, test scores, essay and a STEM teacher recommendation.
pay_detail: 2026 fees: $6,580 on campus, $4,580 virtual, $2,480 for the 10-week fall virtual option. Application fee $95 for summer ($75 fall). Fee waivers for U.S. citizens or green card holders under $80,000 household income or in low-income support programs, limited and first come first served.
duration: 2 weeks (2026: July 13 to 24 on campus; July 27 to Aug 7 virtual)
deadline_text: All 2026 programs closed. The page says the next cycle opens Jan 1, 2027; no 2027 deadline posted. Last cycle: Nov 1, 2025 to Feb 9, 2026.
how_to_apply: Create an account and apply through the MEDCSI SlideRoom portal when the new cycle opens. Needs transcripts, resume, test scores (if available), essay and a STEM teacher recommendation.
notes: Pay-to-play and expensive. Fees shown are 2026 prices. No stipend or work experience. The program also admits undergraduate pre-med students.
